returns.title: Returns and exchanges
returns.description: Check your order before paying. Broken or wrong item: we exchange it for free.
returns.check: On delivery, you can open the parcel in front of the courier and see your items before paying. If the order is not right, you can refuse it and pay nothing.
returns.after: We do not accept returns or exchanges after delivery and payment, except in two cases:
cases: The item arrived broken or faulty.
It is not the item you ordered.
returns.how: Message us within 48 hours of delivery with your order number and a photo, and we will exchange it for free (delivery on us).
returns.hygiene: For hygiene reasons, earrings are only exchanged if they are broken or wrong.

about.title: About us
about.description: Elsanour is a Moroccan shop of elegant fashion jewelry in gift boxes, with cash on delivery across Morocco.
about.p1: Elsanour is a Moroccan shop that picks elegant jewelry for you: necklaces, earrings, rings, bracelets, watches and gift sets.
about.p2: Every order arrives in a gift box, ready to give, for you or for someone you love.
about.p3: We want buying to be simple and worry-free: you order in a minute, we call you to confirm, and you only pay when you receive and check your order.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.description: A question about an item or an order? Contact Elsanour on Instagram or WhatsApp.
contact.intro: A question about an item or your order? We are here to help.
contact.whatsappText: Hello, I have a question from the Elsanour website
contact.orderTip: If it is about an order, mention its number (e.g. #1003) so we can help you faster.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How Elsanour protects your information: what we collect, why, and your rights.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.text: When you order: name, phone number, city, address, any note, and the items you ordered.

sections.title: Why
sections.text: Only to confirm your order by phone and deliver it. The courier only gets what is needed to deliver the parcel; we never sell your information.

sections.title: Where it is kept
sections.text: Your orders are kept in a secure database that only the shop’s admin account can access.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.text: Your basket is kept only on your phone. We use the Meta Pixel (Facebook and Instagram) to measure and improve our ads; it may place cookies in your browser.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: Under Moroccan law 09-08, you can ask at any time to see, correct or delete your information through the “Contact us” page.
